useWhen: Managing complex delivery involving multiple skills
Need to oversee big picture and ensure alignment
Skills need to work together (mini squad)
Deciding which skills to engage for a goal

workflow.description: Understand user's ultimate objective, break down success criteria, determine if new delivery or continuation, gather domain context for skill selection
Determine best approach: Single Skill (simple), Coordinated Skills (multiple sequential), Mini Squad (tight collaboration), or Nested Orchestration (very complex)
Select and engage skills based on strategy. Always include Delivery Manager and Skill Reviewer. Select domain skills as needed
Track progress, monitor for blockers, ensure alignment with vision, adapt plan as needed, communicate status to user
Aggregate outputs from all skills, ensure coherence, present unified result, document learnings

examples.input: Build a complete validation pack for our SaaS idea
examples.output: Coordinated delivery plan with research, persona, business case, and prioritization skills working together
examples.context: Complex goal requiring multiple skills in mini squad mode

examples.input: Help us build and launch a new product
examples.output: Orchestrated delivery with multiple workstreams: validation, technical spec, and development planning
examples.context: Very large goal with nested orchestration for parallel workstreams
